action: If you receive federal payments or use the Treasury's e-Serviços portal, treat messages asking for data, passwords or payments as suspect. Send questions to the Finance Ministry's data protection officer via Fala.BR.
exec: A government finance body disclosed a breach eight days after detection; exposed Pix keys and payment details raise targeted fraud risk.
impact: Some systems and services were temporarily unavailable, with restoration expected by the morning of November 16.
plain: Brazil's Treasury says someone got into two of its databases, exposing about 30,000 people's names, tax IDs and emails and about 4,000 Pix payment keys.

key_findings: Unauthorized access to personal data in two Treasury databases was detected on November 4, 2026 and contained by security monitoring.
About 30,000 e-Serviços portal records were exposed: full name, CPF taxpayer number and registered email.
About 4,000 Pix keys of federal payment beneficiaries and related payment data were exposed from an internal analytics database.
The Treasury reports no financial impact and no core system affected; the origin and extent are still being investigated.
ANPD and the government incident response centre CTIR Gov were notified.
recommendations: Be cautious of unsolicited contacts or messages asking for personal information, passwords or payments.
Send questions to the Finance Ministry's data protection officer through the Fala.BR platform.

sources.name: Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional press note

summary: Brazil's National Treasury disclosed, under the data protection law's breach-notice article, unauthorized access detected on November 4 to two databases: about 30,000 e-Serviços portal registrations (name, CPF, email) and an internal analytics database holding about 4,000 Pix keys and payment data of federal payment recipients. It reports no financial impact and no core system affected, notified ANPD and CTIR Gov, and says the origin is still under investigation.
title: Brazil's National Treasury confirms unauthorized access exposing 30,000 registrations and 4,000 Pix keys
